public.text: Requirements coverage, standards conformance, and capability completeness are presented as ratios. Simple percentages can conceal the failure of a small number of critical requirements and treat all requirements as equally important.
public.suggestedRevision: Weight or stratify measures by criticality. Report mandatory failures separately, prohibit overall pass results where critical requirements fail, and show coverage by safety, security, interoperability, and operational domain.
